q: What steps does a gas-based hydrogen plant follow to report its CBAM emissions?
title: CBAM steps for hydrogen from natural gas
short: Hydrogen (CN 2804 10 00) is charged on direct emissions only. Measure feed and fuel gas, apply the gas analysis and factor, subtract only CO2 that leaves for permanent storage under the rules, and divide by tonnes of hydrogen produced. Keep metering and lab records for a verifier.
audience: Hydrogen producers in India, the Gulf and Asia selling to EU importers

ul: Define the installation and the hydrogen production process inside it.
Meter feed gas and fuel gas, with gas composition from a lab or online analyser.
Calculate CO2 from carbon in feed and fuel.
Deduct captured CO2 only if it goes to recognised permanent storage.
Divide by tonnes of hydrogen produced in the period.

p: Electricity used in the plant is indirect and is not charged for hydrogen under the current rules, but record it, because buyers' footprints may ask.
Hydrogen is outside the 50 tonne yearly exemption, so even small consignments need a figure.
